title: Over 4 lakh march across country, nearly 1,000 arrested - France protests in videos
content: In France, protesters took to the streets, decrying the plight of underfunded schools and spiraling living expenses. This unrest sparked violent confrontations with the police in major cities like Paris and Lyon, where authorities resorted to tear gas and water cannons. As arrests mounted, President Macron's administration faces an escalating challenge, with students and teachers uniting to demand improvements in education and address deep-seated economic disparities affecting their communities.

title: No Virat Kohli in Rahane's all-time India Test XI; picks Dravid, Sachin & Dhoni
content: Rahane, 38, named MS Dhoni as captain and wicketkeeper, explaining that the former India skipper was his first captain in international cricket.

title: 'Act of treason': BJP guns for Farooq Abdullah over 'Pak protecting Kashmiris' remark
content: In recent developments, BJP leaders have taken strong issue with Farooq Abdullah's comments regarding Pakistan's alleged support for Kashmiris. Abdullah, speaking at a workers' gathering, cast doubt on the central government's approach to Jammu and Kashmir, raising questions about India's commitment to justice. In response, BJP representatives charged him with treason, claiming his remarks weaken India's stance on the issue.

title: Michael and Susan Dell’s foundation spotlights free skills training in Texas
content: The Michael & Susan Dell Foundation has reported remarkable achievements among graduates of its skilled-trades training initiatives. Over a dedicated five-week course crafted with input from employers, participants secure jobs almost immediately. Success stories like Mariah showcase a transition into well-paying, stable careers, while Skillpoint Alliance is enhancing training capacities to address Texas's rising need for skilled workers, ultimately promoting economic growth and assisting businesses in meeting workforce challenges.

title: 'Can no longer breathe': Thousands protest in Turkey over media crackdown
content: Thousands demonstrated in Istanbul and Ankara to oppose the government's increasing restrictions on independent media and journalists. Protesters called for press freedom, chanting slogans that emphasized their demand for basic rights. Various media professionals have been arrested recently, raising concerns about freedom of speech in Turkey. Journalists and activists participated in these rallies to highlight the public's right to information.

title: New York court upholds foreclosure dismissal after lender waited 3 years
content: In a significant ruling, a New York appeals court has supported the dismissal of a mortgage foreclosure lawsuit against a borrower after the lender delayed three years to seek a default judgment. New York regulations stipulate that lenders must act within one year of a borrower's non-response to avoid case dismissal. This decision reinforces homeowner protections and emphasizes the importance of timely legal actions in foreclosure matters.

title: Fake faces, stolen voices, false stories: Can we still trust what we see online?
content: Recent incidents highlight how Artificial Intelligence can create deceptive videos and audio that mislead individuals. Eye-witness accounts and authentic recordings can no longer be trusted without verification. High-profile figures have been especially targeted in various scams that exploit technology. It is essential for individuals to adopt cautious practices to combat misinformation effectively. Building digital awareness will help in preserving trust and accountability in online interactions.

title: Delhi school death: Police recover 3-page suicide note, breakup angle under probe
content: An 18-year-old Class 12 student was found burnt on her school premises in Krishna Nagar, Delhi. Police recovered a three-page suicide note, which mentioned family and a friend. Investigators are examining potential motives, including a possible breakup or conspiracy. Family members express disbelief at the possibility of suicide and suspect foul play. The police are pursuing leads and reviewing CCTV footage to understand the circumstances surrounding her death.

title: New Mexico boy, 9, recreates logos from memory and writes in 10 languages
content: Meet Sebastian Esposito, a 9-year-old prodigy from New Mexico, gifted with the ability to write in an impressive ten languages. Diagnosed with autism, his journey took a remarkable turn when he developed hyperlexia, allowing him to read at an early age. With a knack for memorizing the periodic table and identifying flags by their shapes, Sebastian’s parents showcase his extraordinary talents on social media to foster autism awareness.

title: New York court revives privacy claim over cameras filming family's backyard
content: A couple in New York found themselves entangled in a complex property disagreement with their neighbors regarding a disputed land boundary tied to a chain-link fence. This conflict escalated, resulting in claims of trespassing and invasion of privacy due to surveillance cameras. Although the court struggled to rule on the boundary dispute, it has permitted the couple's privacy claims to advance for further scrutiny.

title: Rhode Island volunteers use 600 Christmas trees to restore trout streams
content: In an inspiring environmental effort, volunteers in Rhode Island gathered over 600 old Christmas trees for the 'Trees for Trout' initiative, aimed at restoring riverbanks. By bringing their discarded trees to designated collection sites at Arcadia Management Area, residents have made a significant contribution toward creating sustainable trout habitats and mitigating soil erosion. This project not only enhances local waterways but also promotes community involvement in ecological preservation.

title: 'We are fed up, Macron must give in': Protests erupt across France; cops use tear gas
content: France is taking significant measures to manage mounting tensions, deploying around 70,000 police officers to supervise protests over education funding and escalating living costs. In response to previous violent outbreaks, authorities have restricted protest routes. Major Parisian museums and shops have temporarily closed to prevent potential chaos as demands for enhanced educational opportunities, better salaries, and improved public services grow.

title: 'Boys becoming men': Gambhir's message after Tilak-Nitish pull off thrilling chase
content: In an impressive display, India clinched a stunning four-wicket victory over New Zealand in the second T20I at Christchurch, taking a pivotal 2-0 lead in the series. After a wobbly middle order, Tilak Varma and Nitish Kumar Reddy stepped up in the chase, while Naman Dhir's quick 31 runs helped stabilize the innings.

title: Natalia Granada reveals how her family inspired her F1 Academy journey
content: Natalia Granada takes her first plunge into the F1 Academy, marking a pivotal chapter in her racing narrative. With her family's enthusiasm for Formula 1 as her driving force, she transitioned from go-karting into the fast lane. Juggling education with rigorous training, she receives backing from the Iron Dames organization.

title: How Ons Jabeur went from hotel tennis courts to Grand Slam finals
content: Ons Jabeur’s journey from makeshift courts in hotels in Tunisia to three Grand Slam singles finals is a tale of years of determination, family sacrifice and belief in her distinctive playing style. Jabeur, the first Arab woman to play in a Grand Slam singles final, has broken with tennis tradition and set the stage for young players from Tunisia, North Africa and the wider Arab world.

title: BFI power struggle deepens ahead of October 28 meeting; Boxing fraternity calls for unity
content: Indian boxing is currently undergoing administrative disputes amid a potential no-confidence motion against president Ajay Singh. Key figures in boxing are urging for stability and accountability to protect the sport's growth. An ad-hoc committee has been formed in Jharkhand to address the local association's election issues. BFI secretary general Pramod Kumar has proposed the no-confidence motion to be considered soon.

title: Selena Gomez's October charity gala raised $2.7m for youth mental health
content: Selena Gomez proudly hosted the fourth annual Rare Impact Fund Benefit in Los Angeles, successfully raising significant funds for mental health initiatives. The evening took an exciting turn when her husband, Benny Blanco, bid an impressive $25,000 for a special modeling experience with Gomez’s glam team. During the event, she reaffirmed her dedication to youth mental health and introduced the Katherine Short Legacy Award, with a remarkable total of $2.

title: Haryana student beaten with iron rods; CCTV captures 50 blows in a minute
content: Rudra, a BBA student, suffered severe injuries after being attacked by three men following a motorcycle collision. The incident occurred around 7 pm near Hudda Park in Bhiwani district, causing multiple fractures and serious injuries. CCTV footage reportedly shows the assailants attacking Rudra with sticks and an iron rod while he attempted to escape. His family believes the assault was linked to a previous altercation involving his elder brother Dhruv.

title: ‘What’s with the hate?’: Kriti Sanon reacts to backlash over her Raksha Bandhan ad outfit
content: Kriti Sanon, trolled in August over her “revealing” outfit in a GIVA Raksha Bandhan ad, says her choli became a “national debate.” Speaking to Kareena Kapoor Khan, she said women are scrutinised for everything, criticised those preaching culture while abusing her family online, and added women simply want to not be judged.

title: Pollard doesn't want to see 'yellows and reds', urges MI to put 'team above self'
content: Pollard, who was Mumbai Indians' batting coach for the last four IPL seasons, takes over from Mahela Jayawardene, who parted ways with the franchise last week. The former West Indies all-rounder has been associated with MI since IPL 2010, when he was signed as a player.

title: 45 paise for Rs 10L cover: Rlys extends insurance to counter tickets from Oct 27
content: Starting October 27, Indian Railways will provide travelers the option to include an Optional Travel Insurance Scheme with their reservation ticket purchases. For a nominal fee of just 45 paise, passengers gain crucial coverage for accident-related incidents. The insurance offers various payout options tailored to medical and logistical emergencies. Reservation staff will be responsible for informing ticket buyers about this crucial add-on before finalizing bookings.

title: Tensions mount at Jamia: Classes shift online; AISA alleges assault on students
content: "All Deans/Heads/Directors and faculty members as well as all bonafide students are hereby directed to adhere to the online class schedule and ensure regular participation in academic activities. All faculty members are requested to make the necessary arrangements for conducting classes through online platforms and to provide students with the required academic support and learning materials," the notice read.

title: Cong to launch door-to-door campaign, hold marches over voter list 'discrepancies'
content: Congress aims to register all eligible citizens by the end of December through an extensive campaign. The campaign will include marches, pamphlet distribution, and awareness meetings in both urban and rural areas. Booth-level agents will be appointed to help verify the accuracy of voter lists and report discrepancies. Allegations have arisen regarding significant irregularities affecting millions of voters across the country.

title: Tilak Varma reveals Gambhir's message that inspired him during thrilling chase
content: Tilak Varma shone brightly with an unbeaten 51 runs, leading India to a thrilling victory over New Zealand. Inspired by encouraging words from coaches Gautam Gambhir and Sitanshu Kotak, he anchored the innings in a tense chase, with Nitish Kumar Reddy supporting him with a vital 26 runs. India's last-ball triumph secured a 2-0 lead in the five-match T20I series, highlighting their impressive form.

title: Polio's last strongholds: Why Pakistan and Afghanistan can’t defeat the virus
content: The vaccine works. So why is wild polio still spreading in just two countries and what can India’s own victory teach us?

title: Afghanistan leapfrog England in ODI rankings, reclaim their all-time high position
content: Afghanistan has risen to seventh place in the latest ICC Men's ODI team rankings after defeating Zimbabwe. This victory marks their equal all-time highest ranking, first achieved in May 2025. They bowled Zimbabwe out for 169 runs, completing a comfortable chase led by Ibrahim Zadran's unbeaten 70 runs. India continues to lead the rankings, followed by New Zealand and South Africa.

title: JD(U) expels Anant Singh for 6 years over 'anti-party activities'
content: Janata Dal (United) expelled Mokama MLA Anant Kumar Singh and former MLA Neelam Devi for misconduct. The expulsion was due to Singh’s campaign against the party’s official candidate in legislative elections. Reports indicate that Singh openly supported a rival candidate, contrary to party directives, which led to further disciplinary action. Consequently, the party recommended a disqualification petition to the state assembly speaker.

title: IOA Athletes’ Commission election: 9 sports, 10 seats and uneven representation

title: US on alert as Iran's plan to target Americans abroad in 'advanced stages': Report
content: Amid escalating violence in the region, the United States is curtailing its embassy staff levels in Jordan, Lebanon, Qatar, and the United Arab Emirates. This step follows alarming threats from Iran towards U.S. personnel and Houthi assaults on Saudi territory, prompting the evacuation of non-essential personnel and their families from Saudi Arabia.

title: Abhishek makes history, reaches six-hitting milestone no batter has touched before
content: Abhishek reached the milestone with a six over extra cover off Matt Henry in the third over of India's chase. He had gone past former India captain Rohit Sharma, who hit 98 powerplay sixes in his T20I career, in the series opener on Thursday.

title: Seat ambitions could trip pre-poll alliance talks in Goa
content: As the 2027 assembly elections approach, political parties in Goa are diligently attempting to forge pre-poll alliances, but conflicts abound. The BJP and MGP face tough talks over seat sharing, with MGP pushing for a larger stake. Meanwhile, the opposition, including Congress, GFP, RG, and AAP, grapples with internal divisions and has yet to agree on a unified strategy.

title: Four feet a year: How the Dead Sea is running out of water
content: at 1,400 feet below sea level, the Dead Sea is the lowest point on the planet . its water is nearly 10 times saltier than the ocean, so dense that a person can lie back and float without any effort . every year the sea recedes by around 4 feet, its surface area has shrunk by roughly a third .

title: Riyadh, Dammam, Jeddah flights hit: Air India, IndiGo extend suspensions
content: flights to and from Riyadh and Dammam will remain suspended until 7 November 2026 . services connecting jeddah will remain cancelled until 31 October 2026, the consulate says . escalating tensions in the region have affected travellers, including Indian Umrah pilgrims .

title: US midterms: At Florida rally, Trump vows action against Cuba after Iran war
content: president Donald Trump has said he will turn his attention to Cuba once the war with Iran is settled . his remarks come as his administration continues to tighten pressure on the Cuban government . he reiterated that further military action against Iran could be possible as the administration grapples with rising oil prices .

title: Amit Shah visits Delhi Police HQ amid law and order concerns in Capital
